svg.title: Multi-head attention
svg.desc: The input H, of size T by d, is multiplied by W_Q, W_K and W_V to give Q, K and V, each T by d and each cut into four numbered vertical slices of width d_k = d / n_h. Slice r of Q, K and V goes to head r. Each of the four heads runs masked scaled dot-product attention and produces a lower-triangular T by T weight matrix A^(r) and an output slice V-bar^(r). The four output slices are placed side by side, concatenated into a T by d block, and multiplied by W_proj to give MHA(H), again T by d.
